observed_failure.elaborate_error: LBR-0 Cannot find design m1112r2_c2_k1_async_observation_shadow_wrapper in WORK

root_cause.primary: The r2 shim defines a macro whose name is the old module identifier, then includes a source containing that identifier as a bare token. Verilog/SystemVerilog macros expand only at backtick invocations, so the included source declares m1112_c2_k1_async_observation_shadow_wrapper, not the requested r2 design.
root_cause.analyze_explanation: DC analyze compiles every source into WORK and succeeds because the included old module is legal. It does not prove that DESIGN_NAME exists. Elaborate is the first command that requests the r2 name and therefore emits LBR-0.
root_cause.latent_second_failure: The r2 mapped-VCS TB repeats the same non-invoked macro alias for both its top module and DUT type; a DC-only repair would still fail mapped compilation/elaboration.

successful_invocation_comparison.decisive_difference: Both successful flows pass a file containing a real direct module declaration matching DESIGN_NAME; M1122r4 passes only an include shim with zero module declarations.

minimal_additive_r5_repair.rtl: Create a new r5 RTL file by byte-preserving the frozen base RTL except for exactly one real module-declaration identifier replacement.
minimal_additive_r5_repair.tb: Create a new r5 mapped TB by byte-preserving the frozen base TB except for exactly two replacements: the TB module declaration and the DUT module type.
minimal_additive_r5_repair.filelist: Create a fresh r5 filelist that selects the real r5 RTL, never the r2 alias shim.
minimal_additive_r5_repair.flow: Use a fresh r5 design/TB top, engine, contract, launcher/hammers, attempt/result/work/failure/lock namespaces; reuse the frozen Tcl and selector only by exact hash.
preflight: lexically census exactly one direct RTL top declaration matching DESIGN_NAME
lexically census exactly one direct TB top and one DUT type matching the r5 names
prove the RTL body differs from the frozen base only at the module declaration token
prove the TB body differs from the frozen base only at the TB top and DUT type tokens
run separately authorized directed VCS before any fresh one-shot DC/mapped-VCS attempt

true_wrapper_alternative.reason: It adds parameter/port binding and hierarchy/flatten/reset-census risk while not eliminating the required TB repair.
